cases.title: Web criterion edit and automatic conversation
actions: Add an instruction to one actual criterion: distinguish missing evidence as an item requiring confirmation. Preserve every other criterion and Hiring Brief field.
Observe successful persistence, background summary completion and the automatic company conversation through the real paths.

cases.title: Web Hiring Brief edit and narrow summary input
actions: Append to the actual Hiring Brief a request to distinguish unverified profile facts from confirmed evidence, preserving all existing text and criteria.
Inspect exact before/after snapshots, raw summary request and response, automatic conversation and actual effects.

cases.boundary: Use actual Slack save/executor provenance and captured actor in local transport; block external Slack delivery and do not claim production Slack validation.

cases.title: Identical-value save is a no-op
actions: Read the actual current Hiring Brief and criteria, then submit exactly the same save request twice without changing a value.
Compare history, summary jobs/provider calls, automatic user messages and matching runs before and after.

cases.title: Read real version history through general tools
actions: Perform the same actual criterion edit as ARSB01 once to create a real version and background summary through the product path.
turns: 이 역할의 채용 기준이 최근에 어떻게 바뀌었는지, 수정 시점과 이전·현재 내용, 변경 요약을 기록 기준으로 보여줘. 찾는 기준을 또 바꾸거나 새 검색을 요청하는 것은 아니야.
